name: arca-edge
description: This node's edge: Caddy 2.11.9 with the Cloudflare DNS module (caddybuilds/caddy-cloudflare by digest). It serves the node's routes (route_add): https names passed to instances of this node, certificates by Cloudflare DNS challenge. Arca writes its whole Caddyfile and reloads it. Listens on 443 of one address in kernel.serviceListenAddresses; the port device sends the PROXY header. Set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (Zone DNS Edit) with service_secret_set. Its create runs only from an approved proposal.
